assay: bulk RNA-seq (HiSeq 2500, 2x100 PE, STAR to GRCm38), C2C12 myotubes
primary_estimand: Effect of 24 h electrical pulse stimulation (in vitro exercise model) vs unstimulated control on C2C12 myotube gene expression
sample_inclusion: all 7 deposited samples; control n=3, EPS n=4 (FIG1 legend b,c)
planned_contrasts: EPS vs control (S2.1.p1, FIG1; paper: 774 DEGs, 406 up / 368 down)
paper_method: edgeR negative-binomial test on count data (S4.6.p1, S4.8.p1); CPM log2-transformed and quantile-normalized for expression display
paper_results: 774 DEGs (406 up, 368 down); Table 2 up-regulated secreted genes incl. Prl2c2 logFC 8.80, Areg 2.99, Cxcl1, Cxcl5, Il1b, Gdf15; exercise signature up: Mt1, Mt2, Atf3; down: Myh4, Fam78a, Ppapdc3, Chrne, Kctd12, Il12a (FIG3a,b, S2.2.p3)
secondary_use_of_GSE126001: public in vivo dataset (TAB1: 20-week WT C57BL/6J male, 5 weeks treadmill, gastrocnemius) used only as classifier test set and for cross-dataset direction of EPS genes (S2.1.p3, S2.2.p2, FIG3a,b); no DEG count reported
